```{r}
# required packages
library(sf) # st_read(), st_write(), st_transform()
library(tidyverse) #read_csv(), left_join(), select(), mutate(), filter()
library(janitor) #clean_names()
library(countrycode) #countrycode
library(tmap)
```

```{r}
gii_data <- read_csv("week4/HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv", 
                      locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
                       na = " ", skip=0) 
  
world <- st_read("week4/World_Countries_(Generalized)_2173680399808997149.geojson") %>% clean_names()

world_shp <- st_read("week4/World_Countries_Generalized.shp")
```

```{r}
select_gii_data <- gii_data %>%
  clean_names() %>% 
    select(iso3,country,gii_2010,gii_2019) %>% 
    mutate(gii_diff = gii_2019 - gii_2010) %>% 
    mutate(iso_code=countrycode(country, origin = 'country.name', destination = 'iso2c')) %>%
    mutate(iso_code2=countrycode(iso3, origin ='iso3c', destination = 'iso2c'))
```

```{r}
# Joining the data and selecting columns like iso2 code, select iso3, country, gii 2019, gii 2010, mutate - diff(2019-2010)
gii_world <- select_gii_data %>% 
  left_join(., 
            world,
            by = c("iso_code" = "iso"))
```

```{r}
# Alternative joining of the data, using the world file as the left joined table to maintain its sf data format for mapping
gii_world_2 <- world %>% 
  left_join(.,
            select_gii_data,
            by = c("iso" = "iso_code"))
```


```{r}
# Rebuilding the gii_world object as an sf object to make it a spatial object for mapping
gii_world <- st_as_sf(gii_world)
st_crs(gii_world)
```

```{r}
tm_shape(gii_world) + tm_polygons(fill = "gii_diff")
```
```{r}
tm_shape(gii_world_2) + tm_polygons(fill = "gii_diff")
```
